definitions.gloss: black sugar syrup; dark molasses-like syrup made from unrefined brown sugar
definitions.explanation: A thick, dark syrup made by dissolving unrefined brown sugar ({黒砂糖|くろざとう}) in water and reducing it. It has a deep, rich sweetness with caramel and molasses-like flavors. A staple topping in Japanese traditional confections.

examples.japanese: わらび{餅|もち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{黒蜜|くろみつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
{黒蜜|くろみつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧きな{粉|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせ→組み合わせ：13794_kumiawase⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: The combination of kuromitsu and kinako is the best.

notes:
Combines ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black) and ⟦{蜜|みつ}→蜜：14085_mitsu⟧ (honey, syrup). The "black" refers to the dark color that comes from unrefined brown sugar.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黒蜜|くろみつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to drizzle kuromitsu
- {黒蜜|くろみつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧きな{粉|こ}: kuromitsu and roasted soybean flour
- {黒蜜|くろみつ}⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: kuromitsu flavor
- {黒蜜|くろみつ}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: kuromitsu sauce

CULTURAL NOTE:
{黒蜜|くろみつ} is an essential ingredient in Japanese traditional sweets (⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧). It is the classic topping for わらび{餅|もち} (bracken starch jelly), {葛餅|くずもち} (kuzu starch cake), and ⟦{白玉|しらたま}→白玉：13711_shiratama⟧ (small rice flour dumplings). The combination of {黒蜜|くろみつ} and きな{粉|こ} (roasted soybean flour) is iconic. In recent years, it has also been adopted in modern desserts like parfaits, lattes, and pancakes.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown sugar, raw sugar — the solid form of unrefined sugar from which {黒蜜|くろみつ} is made
- ⟦{蜂蜜|はちみつ}→蜂蜜：14045_hachimitsu⟧: honey — produced by bees, lighter in color and different in flavor
- ⟦{水飴|みずあめ}→水飴：27566_mizuame⟧: starch syrup — a clear, sticky syrup with a milder sweetness
